label: rem:mass-endomorphism-jet-tower
title: Jet-brane reformulation of the mass tower
html: The tower formula limits explicitly to quadratic \hat{V}_i \hat{V}_j coordinates per jet level. The Hecke relation and the \Phi_q pentagon identity are intrinsically quadratic. Triple or higher interactions at level n ascend to level n+1 as new singletons or pairs, ensuring they are captured appropriately by the level-(n+1) contribution. The descended contribution carries a single holonomy contribution from the level-0 unknot core and is not summed iteratively over jet levels.
